name: Deere & Company
fiscalYearEnd: Sunday nearest October 31 (FY2025 ended Nov 2, 2025; Q3 FY2026 ended Aug 2, 2026)
description: Deere sells John Deere tractors, combines, sprayers and other farm equipment, lawn and turf equipment, and construction, forestry and roadbuilding machines (including Wirtgen road machinery), through independent dealers. It also runs a captive finance arm, John Deere Financial, that finances dealer inventory and customer purchases and earned $890M net income in FY2025 on $6.3B of revenue. Equipment revenue is cyclical: farmers buy when crop prices, incomes and interest rates are favorable, so large-ag sales fell 17% in FY2025 (production and precision ag operating profit down 41%) while price realization held up. Profit is driven by volume and price on new machines, with a growing technology and precision-ag layer (software, guidance, automation) and parts and service on the installed fleet. Construction & Forestry has recovered in FY2026.

sub.name: Farm inputs: fertiliser, seeds and farm machinery

gics.note: Conventional GICS label from general knowledge; not re-checked against MSCI/S&P. SEC SIC 3523 (Farm Machinery & Equipment).

hq.note: One John Deere Place, Moline, IL 61265 (FY2025 10-K cover); Delaware corporation incorporated 1958

employees.note: About 73,100 employees, of which about 32,500 full-time production; 27,000 in the US (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Production & Precision Agriculture (PPA)
businessLines.how: Sells expensive machines to dealers/farmers at high margin, plus technology (guidance, automation) and parts; volume follows farm income and interest rates. Sales volume -17% in FY2025, US/Canada -30%, Brazil +22%.
businessLines.description: Large tractors, combines, cotton and sugarcane harvesters, planters, sprayers and precision-agriculture technology for production-scale growers of large grains, small grains, cotton and sugarcane.

operatingProfit.note: equipment operations segment operating profit; share computed against the $4,906M sum of the three equipment segments (Financial Services reports net income instead)

businessLines.name: Small Agriculture & Turf (SAT)
businessLines.how: Sells smaller tractors, mowers and turf equipment through dealers and retailers; steadier than large ag (dairy and livestock margins, residential mowing).
businessLines.description: Equipment for dairy and livestock producers, high-value and small-acreage crops, and turf and utility customers (tractors, mowers).

operatingProfit.note: equipment operations segment operating profit; share computed against the $4,906M sum of the three equipment segments (Financial Services reports net income instead)

businessLines.name: Construction & Forestry (CF)
businessLines.how: Sells machines through dealers; price incentives were needed in FY2025 (price realization -2%, US/Canada -3%) as competition rose; tariffs cut margin.
businessLines.description: Excavators, dozers, motor graders, wheel loaders, backhoes, articulated dump trucks, compact construction equipment, forestry and Wirtgen roadbuilding equipment.

operatingProfit.note: equipment operations segment operating profit; share computed against the $4,906M sum of the three equipment segments (Financial Services reports net income instead)

businessLines.name: Financial Services (John Deere Financial)
businessLines.how: Earns interest on receivables and leases funded by borrowings; profit is the spread, and the business follows equipment sales volume.
businessLines.description: Finances dealers' inventory and retail purchases and leases of Deere equipment (agriculture, turf, construction).

brands.name: Wirtgen, Vogele, Hamm, Kleemann, Benninghoven, Ciber
